sections.What we use it for:
`kac.core` references it. The checks that read a document body run on what it produces, so `h1`, `identity`,
`sections`, `link-resolves` and `undefined-label` all read the same parse.
sections.Licence and obligations: BSD-2-Clause. It asks that the copyright notice travel with source and binary redistributions. A NuGet package states the licence expression in its own metadata, so publishing `kac` needs nothing further.
